Game Overview

In Knock It Down, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a fast-paced showdown with cunning bots in Knock It Down. Sharpen your aim to shoot balloons and snatch them from the competition. Quick reflexes and spot-on accuracy will earn you victory as you race to score points before your rivals.

How to Play

Each session of Knock It Down follows a consistent rhythm. Dive into a fast-paced showdown with cunning bots in Knock It Down! Sharpen your aim to shoot balloons and snatch them from the competition. Quick reflexes and spot-on accuracy will earn you victory as you race to score points before your rivals.
